section3_1_checksum.note: sha256sum -c: 14/14 OK. CHECKSUMS.sha256 itself is conventionally self-excluded from its own listing (not an anomaly). asset_manifest.jsonl hashes to the well-known empty-string SHA-256 (e3b0c4...) -- file is intentionally 0 bytes, not corrupt.

section3_2_handoff.finding: HANDOFF_HEAD_COMMIT_EMPTY: HANDOFF.json's head_commit field is an empty string, so it cannot be cross-checked against the actual branch HEAD by a downstream consumer without independently resolving the branch tip. Not a checksum/integrity failure (all listed manifest/coverage/checksum paths are present and non-empty), but a metadata completeness defect worth fixing in a future release.

section3_3_coverage_recalculated.note: 79 (complete+unverified) + 5 (2019 preLaunch, outside target window) + 1 (2026-08 partial, outside target window, current-month in-progress) = 85 total rows. All figures recalculated directly from monthly_coverage.csv, not copied from Agent 1's report; they match Agent 1's reported figures exactly.

section3_4_completeMonthIdCounts.globalDistinctReason: Release only ships aggregate firstPostingId/lastPostingId ranges per month, not the actual per-record ID list. Those ranges overlap heavily across the 11 complete months (e.g. 2020-02 range 29589-38086 sits inside 2020-01's 24563-40878), so summing monthly distinct counts cannot be assumed equal to a true cross-month-deduplicated count. Treat 11,825 as sumOfMonthlyDistinctIds only, not as a verified global distinct count.
section3_4_completeMonthIdCounts.finding: COMPLETE_MONTH_EXPECTED_VS_RETURNED_MISMATCH: All 11 'complete' months show returnedDistinctCount strictly less than expectedTotalCount (gap 10 to 611 ids, up to ~24%), yet each row's free-text note asserts '.../... distinct ids collected == expected'. The note's own numbers contradict its own '== expected' claim. discoveredCount == returnedDistinctCount in every row, so the de-dup step itself looks consistent -- the mismatch is between the collected set and expectedTotalCount, not a de-dup bug. This needs clarification from Agent 1 (does expectedTotalCount include activityTypes outside recruit, or a different query scope than what was actually collected?) before 'complete' can be trusted as == fully paginated against the same denominator used to certify it.

section3_6_rawLineage.finding: crawl_manifest.jsonl documents only 6 discrete fetch events (1 NCS file, 1 aggregated n=126 summary bundle, 3 single-posting masked fixtures, 1 GraphQL sample carried over from CRAWL_20260806_01) -- there is no per-posting-record manifest row (sourceUrl/rawPath/rawSha256/httpStatus/fetchedAt/collectorVersion/crawlRunId/sourcePostingId) for the thousands of postings implied by monthly_coverage.csv. This matches Agent 1's own disclosure in HANDOFF.known_gaps and the row-2 note ('raw HTML per-posting was NOT persisted this pass'). Independently confirmed, not merely copied.

section3_7_ncsFile.missingHierarchyNote: The source CSV carries only the leaf unit code (분류번호, 15-char e.g. '0101010101_17v2') and its own name (명칭) -- no separate major/middle/minor/sub CODE columns, and critically no major/middle/minor/sub NAME columns at all. Hierarchy codes (major=01/middle=01/minor=01/sub=01/unit=01 + version suffix _17v2) can be parsed out of the 10-digit code prefix, but the human-readable NAMES for major/middle/minor/sub categories are not present anywhere in this file and would require a separate NCS classification/hierarchy reference table not included in this release. This blocks populating majorName/middleName/minorName/subName in the Phase B normalized schema until that reference is sourced.
